'''Yasuhiro Mamiya''' ('''間宮 康弘''' ''Mamiya Yasuhiro'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Mamiya was born on December 7, 1981, in {{wp|Chiba Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where his first role was [[Lana's father]]. Mamiya gained additional roles during {{aniseries|JN}}, most notably [[Ash's Gengar]] and [[Goh's Darmanitan]]. Mamiya is currently affiliated with the talent agency Kenyuu Office.
